title: Unsafe paths and changing environment snapshots
summary: An environment may change during package installation or replacement. Symlinked metadata and changed cfg or distribution inventories prevent a stable static snapshot and must preserve uncertainty.
checks: Repeat after installation/replacement activity has finished and approve every external base path explicitly.
Keep venv instance identity and deployment timing scoped to the application process under investigation.
limitations: Reads reject metadata symlinks and nonregular files; there is no filesystem-wide atomic snapshot guarantee.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
